command:
echo 'Waiting for PostgreSQL to be ready...'
until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U ""; do 
  sleep 5
done

# CRITICAL SAFEGUARD: Checks if data tables exist before running database seed imports
echo 'Checking if database is already initialized...'
TABLE_COUNT=$(psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U "" -d "" -t -c "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" | tr -d '[:space:]')

if [ -z "" ] || [ "" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'Database empty! Importing backup...'
  psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U "" -d "" < /tmp/huntersspeak_latest_postgres_new.sql
  echo 'Import complete.'
else
  echo "Database already contains data ( tables found). Skipping import routine to prevent data corruption."
fi

echo 'Importer tasks complete. Entering sleep lock...'
tail -f /dev/null
containers.name: postgres-importer

annotations.kubernetes.io/description: Contains a CA bundle that can be used to verify the kube-apiserver when using internal endpoints such as the internal service IP or kubernetes.default.svc. No other usage is guaranteed across distributions of Kubernetes clusters.

 SELECT feed.id,

--
-- Name: feed_view; Type: VIEW; Schema: public; Owner: admin
--

CREATE VIEW public.feed_view AS
 SELECT feed.id,
    feed.user_id,
    feed.photo_count,
    feed.video_count,
    feed.created_at,
    feed.active,
    feed.share_to,
    feed.data,
    feed.resource_type
   FROM ( SELECT posts.id,
            posts.user_id,
            posts.photo_count,
            posts.video_count,
            posts.created_at,
            posts.active,
            posts.share_to,
            jsonb_build_object('id', posts.id, 'user_id', posts.user_id, 'respeakable_id', posts.respeakable_id, 'slug', posts.slug, 'title', posts.title, 'content', posts.content, 'comment', posts.comment, 'description', posts.description, 'location_name', posts.location_name, 'created_at', posts.created_at, 'share_to', posts.share_to) AS data,
            'post'::text AS resource_type
           FROM public.posts
        UNION ALL
         SELECT discussions.id,
            discussions.user_id,
            discussions.photo_count,
            discussions.video_count,
            discussions.created_at,
            discussions.active,
            discussions.share_to,
            jsonb_build_object('id', discussions.id, 'user_id', discussions.user_id, 'respeakable_id', discussions.respeakable_id, 'slug', discussions.slug, 'title', discussions.title, 'location_name', discussions.location_name, 'content', discussions.content, 'comment', discussions.comment, 'description', discussions.description, 'created_at', discussions.created_at, 'share_to', discussions.share_to) AS data,
            'discussion'::text AS resource_type
           FROM public.discussions
        UNION ALL
         SELECT listings.id,
            listings.user_id,
            listings.photo_count,
            listings.video_count,
            listings.created_at,
            listings.active,
            listings.share_to,
            jsonb_build_object('id', listings.id, 'user_id', listings.user_id, 'respeakable_id', listings.respeakable_id, 'slug', listings.slug, 'title', listings.title, 'price', listings.price, 'price_type', listings.price_type, 'min_price', listings.min_price, 'max_price', listings.max_price, 'date_from', listings.date_from, 'date_to', listings.date_to, 'location_name', listings.location_name, 'content', listings.content, 'comment', listings.comment, 'description', listings.description, 'created_at', listings.created_at, 'share_to', listings.share_to, 'type', listings.type, 'category_id', listings.category_id, 'status_id', listings.status_id, 'reviewable', listings.reviewable) AS data,
            'listing'::text AS resource_type
           FROM public.listings) feed;

command:
echo 'Waiting for PostgreSQL to be ready...'
until pg_isready -h 127.0.0.1 -U ""; do 
  sleep 5
done

# CRITICAL SAFEGUARD: Checks if data tables exist before running database seed imports
echo 'Checking if database is already initialized...'
TABLE_COUNT=$(psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U "" -d "" -t -c "SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.tables WHERE table_schema='public';" | tr -d '[:space:]')

if [ -z "" ] || [ "" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo 'Database empty! Importing backup...'
  psql -h 127.0.0.1 -U "" -d "" < /tmp/huntersspeak_latest_postgres_new.sql
  echo 'Import complete.'
else
  echo "Database already contains data ( tables found). Skipping import routine to prevent data corruption."
fi
